name: Rei
title: David's Faithful Friend
summary: Rei was one of King David's loyal men who did not join Adonija in his attempt to seize the throne. He is mentioned in connection with the struggle for succession toward the end of David's reign, where he remained faithful to both David and Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Adonija's Rebellion
keyEvents.description: When Adonija attempted to seize power, Rei was among those who did not support him but remained loyal to King David.

keyEvents.title: Faithfulness to David
keyEvents.description: Rai is mentioned together with other faithful men such as Benaiah and David's warriors, all of whom rejected Adonijah's claim to the throne.

keyEvents.title: Solomon's Accession Secured
keyEvents.description: Through the loyalty of men like Rai, Benaiah, Zadok, and the prophet Nathan, Solomon's accession was made possible in accordance with David's will.

keyEvents.title: Adonijah's Feast at En-Rogel
keyEvents.description: Adonijah invited his supporters to a feast at En-Rogel, but Rai was among those deliberately not invited because he was known for his loyalty to David.
